defects.justification: Any client can create any number of rooms (no cap per client or globally), and a room that has history is never deleted, so a client that joins and posts once in many distinct room names keeps up to 50 x 4000-byte messages per room in memory forever; the README admits the room count is not capped.

publish has no per-client message rate limit, so one connection can flood a room with up to 4000-byte messages that fan out to every member, overflowing their 256-frame buffers and getting legitimate slow clients disconnected.
serveWS accepts unlimited WebSocket connections, each with its own goroutines and 256-slot send buffer, and nothing caps the total or per-IP connection count.
